text.en:
There is hereby appropriated, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise
appropriated, the sum of one million pesos which shall be given as aid for the immediate rehabilitation of the
Philippine Tubercolosis Society, including the Quezon Institute as well as of other agencies engaged in the
fight against and the control of tubercolosis: Provided, That the amount of eight hundred thousand pesos shall
be set aside for the Philippine Tubercolosis Society and the Quezon Institute.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, September 24, 1945.
